name: markov
description: Markov-chain transition-probability strategy compiled to a WASM module. Classifies each bar Bull/Bear/Stagnant by the sign of its move, then a fixed 3x3 transition matrix plus a cyclic counter pick the next state: Bull targets long, Bear short, Stagnant flat. Moves to the target each bar (open/hold/close/reverse); on spot a Bear target only closes a long.
